goals: I can talk about my free time.
I can give a reason with so and because.
I can compromise with my friends.
sentences: What do you do in your free time?
Name 3 things you do in your free time and explain why you like them.
Where does the reason go — after so or after because?
I'm a very social person, **so** I always want to socialize.
I'm tired, **so** I take a nap.
Working out is important **because** I can't exercise while studying.
I read a lot **because** I love new ideas.
What are they doing?
The intellectual student reads only her schoolbooks.
